column1: # tests/memfn/rows.tsv — THE KIT'S ROW MANIFEST ([MEMFN-ROWCON] N4,
# docs/design/memfn/row_contracts.md rev 4.1 §4). HAND-MAINTAINED: one line
# per row of each of the kit's selection tables (the composer's arms,
# memfn/src/compose.c `arms[]`, the run compare's rows, memfn/src/runcmp.c,
# and the offset-skip function's `fn_rows[]`, memfn/src/ofsskip.c, every
# slot; R4e'.0). It is NOT derived from fields.def or from the kit's
# sources: run_rows.sh derives the kit's actual row set independently (an
# MF_TRACE build of the kit prints every row of every table at exit) and
# fails if the two disagree in EITHER direction.
# A row added to the kit adds its line here in the same commit (or the
# check is red); a row deleted deletes its line.
# Columns (TAB-separated; `-` is empty):
#   table      `arms`, `runcmp` or `fn` (the trace's table names)
#   row        the row's name (the trace's `row=`)
#   reach      WHY the row exists, from a CLOSED set:
#                pcrec                    pcrec's corpus reaches it (the census
#                                         floor in row_floors.tsv holds it)
#                total-fallback           the table's last row: chosen only when
#                                         no other row serves a site
#                pending-site:<trigger>   built ahead of the pcrec site that
#                                         will reach it; <trigger> names it
#                contract-reach:<family>  reached only by the kit's contract
#                                         tests; <family> is a G2 family
#                                         (memfn/tests/run_g2.sh FAM_FLOORS)
#              Anything else is refused: a row with no reason is deleted (D77).
#   wkind      `pattern` (a pcrec compile; required for reach=pcrec) or
#              `fixture` (a tests/memfn/arm_fixtures.c fixture; required for
#              every other reach)
#   wflags     pcrec flags for the witness compile (pattern only), space-
#              separated, after `-p rx --features all`
#   witness    the pattern text, or the fixture name
#   signature  a short literal of the ROW'S rendering: it must be in the
#              witness's artifact, and the trace must show the row chosen
#              there. `\n`, `\t` and `\\` are escapes.
#   cflags     pcrec flags for the control compile (pattern only)
#   control    the control: `=` (the witness pattern again, under cflags),
#              another pattern, or another fixture. In the control artifact
#              the row must NOT be chosen and the signature must be ABSENT.
# [REQ-HANDOFF-L1] (abi 75): the two bounded start-scan rows' witnesses add
# `-fno-req-handoff`; their pattern's pre-check handoff otherwise re-enters
# (NEXT's `handoff` row ranks above the start-byte rows).
# [MEMFN] R17-b' B1 (lane fdb1): table `fd`, the finder table (memfn/src/
# finder.c `fd_rows[]`), 17 rows since B4' (lane b4p: R0, R5 and R7 withdrawn,
# ids reserved). A `fd` FIND row's signature is read from the traced compile's
# `MFTRACE FDROUTE` record (row and arm): a decided row's pick renders
# exactly the text its pre-table arm did (zero movers), so the artifact's text
# cannot tell the decision apart (r17b_prime.md §1.6 [rev3 B5]). Every `fd`
# row's reach is `pending-site:<its step>` (r17b_prime.md §3.4 [rev3 B7]) or
# `pcrec`; a row no site can reach (it reads E, H, a W64 pick, or a fast
# terminal) has witness kind `-` and prints UNREACHED with its step. R17-b'
# B2 (lane fdb2) routed D1, D1c and D1w: their reach is `pcrec`, their
# witness a pattern. R17-b' B3b (lane b3b) routed slot PRES (P0, P2, P3, P4,
# P9) and D2: the PRES rows' reach is `pcrec`, their witness a pattern, their
# signature the `MFTRACE FD ... slot=PRES` record of the deciding row and the
# span's final link (the define's records, phase define; P2's, whose
# pre-check is never defined, the presence ask's, phase ask, chosen at phase
# SHADOW); P9 is reached under P3's deny (`--memfn=no-fd-pres-pick`), P4's
# signature is the HEAD member's `+P4`. D2 (a FIND site over a RUN span 0, no
# pcrec builder ever stated one) RETIRED at D172 S2 commit 6 (window_site.md
# §2.2), its row with it.
# R7w, the default every set FIND takes (B4', MEASURED by the walk ruling), is
# `pcrec`: its signature is the FDROUTE record's, its control a one-byte site D1
# claims. PAIR (code review r1 C1, lane s3) decides the stop of a window site
# E-find renders (fd_find); its FDROUTE record names `arm=E-find`, its control
# the same pattern under E-find's deny (the composite path, no window stop). A row DECIDED AT THE ASK (lane b3breach, the kit manager's ruling)
# says so in its SIGNATURE: the `MFTRACE FD` record's ` phase=ask` is part of
# it (P2 today, whose pre-check is asked and never defined). n2_report.py
# --floors holds such a row to its floor on the REACH line's `asked=N`
# (selections decided at the ask), every other row on `chosen`; rows_check.py
# requires its witness to be ASKED (asked >= 1) and its control not, and every
# traced compile's `asked` to equal its own `phase=ask` FD records (P4 counted
# from `P3+P4`).
# R-26.6 (lane r26zk): RPT, the REPORT row, held for its preview step, RETIRED
# at D172 S3 with the preview (window_site.md §4): a REPORT site is a window
# site, rendered by the window family's E-find row; one stated in terms is
# refused on every art, which tests/memfn/proof_check.c holds.
# The control is what makes a signature mean something (learnings §3): a
# literal that also appears where the row is not chosen proves nothing.
# run_rows.sh also holds every signature to EVERY artifact it compiled and
# every fixture: wherever the signature appears, the trace must show its row.
# D172 S3: the fixed-width witnesses of pf_memchr_bounded and pf_walk_bounded
# are `cover` artifacts by default (the memfn kit's window site, no
# prefilter), so witness and control both carry the cover row's deny
# `--memfn=no-window-search`, the default build before S3. Since the S3 code review
# (C1, C2) fn-pair's and vrun-w16/w32's witness `(?i)cat` is on the DEFAULT
# path again: the cover's window search stops at a cube, decided PAIR, and
# renders the offset-skip function `<prefix>_mf<h>_ofsskip` (fn-pair's body,
# vrun's rungs under -fmemfn-simd); each control is the row's own deny.
